title: energy_ceasefire_short
question: Will Russia really stop? Comment below

scenes.name: Donald J. Trump
scenes.post: Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE... Do not break it!

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump just announced a *ceasefire*. Russia hasn't agreed to it.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Effective immediately, he wrote, there is an *energy ceasefire* between Russia and Ukraine. *Do not break it*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: No details. No terms. Nobody said *who would check*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Hours later, Ukraine says Russia hit a *power plant in Kharkiv*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky says he learned about it *from the media*. We support it, he said, but *this looks strange*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: His offer to Moscow? *Don't attack us. Don't kill our children.* We will stop attack your diesel.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The Kremlin? Only that *contacts are ongoing*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: It comes two days after Trump's *diesel deal* with Putin, as U.S. diesel sits near *record prices*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Ukraine's refinery strikes are *cutting Russian diesel* out of the market.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: And Trump said the *same thing* last month. The strikes never stopped.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Will it work this time? *Tell us in the comments*.
